claims: Frozen Four overtime consists of 20-minute sudden-death periods.
Frozen Four overtime periods are played at full 5-on-5 strength.
Frozen Four overtime continues until a team scores.
There is no 3-on-3 hockey in the Frozen Four.
There is no shootout in the Frozen Four.
Ice resurfacing occurs between Frozen Four overtime periods if necessary.
If a Frozen Four overtime period ends tied, a full ice resurface and intermission occur before the next period.
Penalties carry over from regulation and previous overtime periods in the Frozen Four.
Frozen Four overtime rules are similar to the NHL playoffs.
Frozen Four overtime rules are used for both the national semifinals and championship games
